de.aboutBlurb: A motion-graphics and compositing editor. Free software under the GNU General Public Licence, version 3.
de.aeAudioLayerAsFootage: imported as a footage layer carrying its audio
de.aeAudioLevelsDiffer: audio levels {left} dB left and {right} dB right have one level in Lumit — imported at the left
de.aeBlendModeUnavailable: blend mode {aeMode} has no equivalent — imported as Normal
de.aeChunkUnreadable: a record in the project file ({chunk}) could not be read and was skipped
de.aeCompDurationGuessed: no duration arrived — imported {used} seconds long
de.aeCompFrameRateGuessed: no frame rate arrived — imported at {used} fps
de.aeCompMissing: no composition data arrived — imported empty
de.aeCompStartIgnored: the composition's timecode started at {start} seconds — imported starting at zero
de.aeCouldNotImport: There is no Lumit bundle at {path}
de.aeEffectAsPlugin: {matchName} imported as the {plugin} plug-in you have installed, which is the same effect — {carried} of its {controls} controls carried across by name
de.aeEffectNearest: {matchName} is somebody else's effect — {instead} is the closest in Lumit and imported in its place, at its own defaults
de.aeEffectParamNotCarried: {effect}'s {param} has no equivalent — the effect imported without it
de.aeEffectParamRebased: {effect}'s {param} was measured in After Effects' units — imported as the same length in Lumit's
de.aeEffectParamsUnreadable: {count} parameters could not be read — they are kept whole and import as nothing
de.aeEffectPlaceholder: {matchName} imported as a placeholder — every parameter is kept and it renders nothing
de.aeEffectSpeedAsKeyframes: {effect}'s {param} read the clock — imported as keyframes running at the same rate
de.aeEffectSuggestion: {matchName} imported as a placeholder — {instead} does this job in Lumit
de.aeExpressionCarried: the expression imported as source text and drives the property
de.aeExpressionDisabledCarried: a switched-off expression — its text is kept, and it drives nothing
de.aeExpressionNotRunnable: the expression does not run here and was switched off — its text is kept, and the keyframes underneath drive the property: {source}
de.aeFlowEngineDiffers: Pixel Motion imported as flow interpolation — a different flow engine, so in-betweens differ
de.aeGuideLayerNotSupported: guide layers have no equivalent — imported visible
de.aeItemUnreadable: the item could not be read and was skipped
de.aeLayerKindUnsupported: layer kind {aeKind} has no equivalent — imported as a null so parenting survives
de.aeLayerQualityIgnored: layer quality {quality} has no equivalent — imported at full quality
de.aeLayerSourceMissing: the source item {id} is not in the capture — imported as a null so parenting survives
de.aeLayerSpanRepaired: the layer's in and out points did not make a span — imported one frame long
de.aeLayerUnreadable: the layer had no place in the stack and was skipped
de.aeLightKindApproximated: a {aeKind} light has no equivalent — imported as the nearest kind
de.aeMaskFeatherAxesDiffer: feather {x} × {y} has one width in Lumit — imported at their average
de.aeMaskModeUnavailable: mask mode {aeMode} is not built yet — imported as Add
de.aeMaskRotoBezierFlattened: a RotoBezier mask's curves are computed by After Effects — imported as its polygon
de.aeMatteTargetMissing: the matte layer {index} is not in this composition — imported with no matte
de.aeMediaMissing: the file at {path} was missing in After Effects too
de.aeMediaNotFound: the file is not on this machine — imported offline, ready to relink
de.aeMediaPlaceholder: an After Effects placeholder, not a real file
de.aeNestedPreserveBoth: preserve frame rate and resolution when nested has no equivalent — nested comps follow the parent
de.aeNestedPreserveRate: preserve frame rate when nested has no equivalent — nested comps follow the parent
de.aeNestedPreserveResolution: preserve resolution when nested has no equivalent — nested comps follow the parent
de.aeOrientationNotCarried: the layer turns by orientation as well as by rotation — the rotation is what arrives, and the orientation is not carried
de.aeParentMissing: the parent layer {index} is not in this composition — imported unparented
de.aePixelAspectIgnored: pixel aspect ratio {par} has no equivalent — imported with square pixels
de.aePointOfInterestNotCarried: a two-node camera aims at its point of interest — Lumit's camera aims by its own rotation, so the point of interest is not carried
de.aePreserveTransparencyNotSupported: preserve underlying transparency has no equivalent yet — not applied
de.aeProjectBlendingDiffers: the project blended at {bits} bits without linear blending — Lumit composites in scene-linear light, so blends can shift slightly
de.aePropertyUnreadable: After Effects could not read {matchName} itself, so there was nothing to import
de.aeRendererUnrecognised: the {renderer} renderer's features do not import — layers arrive flat
de.aeShapeContentsNotMapped: shape contents are not imported yet — the layer keeps its place and draws nothing
de.aeSpatialTangentsFlattened: the motion path's spatial tangents are not carried — each axis animates on its own
de.aeStretchAsRetime: time stretch {percent}% imported as the equivalent Retime
de.aeTextStylingNotMapped: the words, size and fill colour imported; the rest of the styling did not
de.badgePluginFailed: This plugin did not render this frame
de.badgePluginMissing: This plugin is not installed on this machine
de.badgeUnknownEffect: This build does not know this effect
de.cacheDeleteTitle: Delete the frames parked on disk?
de.cloneSourceFirst: Alt-click to set the clone source first
de.colourOutsideRange: Outside 0–1: the swatch and hex are clipped
de.couldNotAddShapeLayer: Could not add a shape layer
de.couldNotAddTextLayer: Could not add a text layer

de.dropProjectFile: A Lumit project is opened rather than imported — use File › Open project.

de.exportColourConfigUntagged: A file written through the colour configuration is left untagged rather than mis-tagged.

de.exportPresetReadOnly: "{name}" is a built-in preset and cannot be changed

de.keymapClashPanelCount: {count, plural, =1{One shortcut means something else in one panel} other{{count} shortcuts mean something else in one panel}}

de.nodeNoSelection: Pick a node in the Graph panel.
de.ocioConfigUnreadable: the colour config {path} could not be read, so the built-in transform is in use
de.ocioContextVariable: this config uses context variables in the path {path}, which Lumit does not support yet
de.ocioLutFileNotFound: the look-up table {name} was not found on this config's search path
de.ocioNonMonotoneCurve: the curve in {path} does not rise or fall consistently, so it cannot be inverted
de.ocioSingularMatrix: a matrix in this transform has no inverse
de.ocioTableTooLarge: a look-up table in {what} is larger than Lumit allows ({size} points, limit {limit})
de.ocioUnknownColourSpace: this config has no colour space named {name}
de.ocioUnknownDisplay: this config has no display named {name}
de.ocioUnknownLook: this config has no look named {name}
de.ocioUnknownRole: this config does not define the {name} role
de.ocioUnknownView: the display {display} has no view named {view}
de.ocioUnsupported3dLutInverse: the colour space {space} would have to invert a 3D look-up table, which Lumit refuses rather than approximate
de.ocioUnsupportedBuiltin: this config needs the built-in transform {style}, which Lumit does not support yet
de.ocioUnsupportedClfFeature: this look-up table uses {feature}, which Lumit does not support yet
de.ocioUnsupportedClfNode: this look-up table uses the {node} process node, which Lumit does not support yet
de.ocioUnsupportedConfigVersion: this config is written for OCIO profile version {version}, which Lumit does not read yet
de.ocioUnsupportedLutFormat: Lumit does not read look-up tables in {extension} files yet
de.ocioUnsupportedTransform: this config needs {name}, which Lumit does not support yet
de.planarPartial: Tracked {frames} of {total} frames — the surface could not be followed further
de.planarReanchored: {count, plural, =1{Re-anchored once, so the far end may drift a little} other{Re-anchored {count} times, so the far end may drift a little}}
de.precomposeAdjustDuration: Adjust the duration to the span of the selected layers
de.precomposeFailed: Those layers could not be pre-composed.
de.precomposeLeaveHelp: Use this option to create a new intermediate composition with only '{layer}' in it. The new composition will become the source to the current layer.
de.precomposeMove: Move all attributes into the new composition
de.precomposeMoveHelp: Use this option to place the currently selected layers together into a new intermediate composition.
de.previewStopped: The preview has stopped; reopen the project to start it again
de.projectColourNoConfig: No configuration: Lumit's own colour handling is in use.
de.projectColourNotInForce: Not in force: {reason}. The built-in colour handling is being used instead.
de.projectEmpty: No items yet — import footage or create a composition
de.recoveryQuestion: It looks like Lumit crashed with unsaved changes, would you like to restore them?
de.selectACompositionFirst: Select a composition in the Project panel.
de.selectALayerToPaint: Select a layer to paint on
de.settingsAudioDeviceMissing: That device is not connected — playing through the system default until it is back.
de.settingsAudioNoDevice: This machine has no audio output.
de.settingsAutosaveOff: Autosave is off — only the crash journal is protecting unsaved work.
de.settingsGroupPreviewCacheOnTheGraphics: Preview cache on the graphics card
de.settingsHelpAntiAliasing: Smooths the edges of rotated and scaled layers. Saved in the project, and the same for the preview and the export.
de.settingsHelpAntiAliasingInUse: This graphics card does not offer the setting above, so Lumit is using the highest it does. The project is unchanged.
de.settingsHelpAutomaticUpdates: Look for a new version of Lumit when it starts, at most once a day. Nothing is downloaded until you ask for it.
de.settingsHelpCacheBudget: How much memory finished frames may hold, of the {total} this machine has.
de.settingsHelpCacheInUse: {hits} of {requests} frames were served from the cache; {decodes} were decoded.
de.settingsHelpChromeLabels: Whether buttons, tabs and toggles show their word or the glyph that stands for it. Hover text always says the word, whichever you choose, and anything you typed yourself is never turned into a picture.
de.settingsHelpColourScheme: The palette every panel draws from.
de.settingsHelpCompact: Draw rows a little tighter, so more of a layer stack and more parameters fit on screen. Nothing else changes.
de.settingsHelpCorners: How rounded controls and panels are.
de.settingsHelpCustomColours: Start from this scheme and set any colour yourself.
de.settingsHelpDiskBudget: How much disk space parked frames may take. These survive closing Lumit, so a project reopens warm.
de.settingsHelpFramesWaitingToBeWritten: The write-behind queue to the disk cache, which is bounded at eight frames.
de.settingsHelpGraphicsMemoryReserved: What the driver has taken from the system for those, and how much of it is in use. The gap is memory Lumit has released and the driver has not handed back.
de.settingsHelpHeldByTheGraphicsDriver: Pictures and buffers the driver still has for Lumit. A handful is normal — the frames on the card, the ones being made. Thousands means pictures the engine finished with were never destroyed, and on a Mac that memory is inside the total above.
de.settingsHelpInUse: Frames held on the card, ready to show without compositing.
de.settingsHelpInUse2: Frames on disk, one promotion away from playing.
de.settingsHelpInterfaceScale: How large every panel draws, for a dense or a distant screen.
de.settingsHelpLanguage: What Lumit is written in. Translations come from volunteers, so a new language may be part English at first.
de.settingsHelpMotion: How much controls animate as they change.
de.settingsHelpNotHeldByAnyCache: The process, less every store above that is inside it — which on this machine includes the frames on the card. A large number here is not a cache to shrink: it is memory nothing in this window is counting, and it is worth reporting.
de.settingsHelpNowhereToPark: Nowhere: this machine has no folder Lumit may write to.
de.settingsHelpOpenMediaDecoders: One per footage item in play. Each holds buffers of its own that no budget here covers.
de.settingsHelpPanelLayout: Return every panel to its default place and size.
de.settingsHelpPasteLayersAtTheirOriginal: A pasted layer keeps the timecode it was copied at, instead of starting at the playhead. For rebuilding the same moment in a second composition; leave it off for the everyday "put one here". Effects always paste with their first keyframe at the playhead, whichever way this is set.
de.settingsHelpPlayheadStaysWherePlaybackSt: Leave the playhead on the frame that was on screen when playback stopped, instead of putting it back where playing started. Dragging the ruler while playing always stops and follows the pointer, whichever way this is set.
de.settingsHelpQualityTier: What the realtime controller has settled on.
de.settingsHelpRetimeOpensToVelocity: The Retime graph opens showing playback speed per cent — one point per keyframe, dragged up to speed up and below zero to reverse — instead of which moment of the source is showing.
de.settingsHelpRetimeValuesInSeconds: The Retime row shows which moment of the source is playing as a number of seconds, instead of as a timecode in the same HH:MM:SS:FF form as every other time in the editor. Seconds can say a position between two frames; a timecode cannot.
de.settingsHelpScopeEverywhere: Every project that has not been given a place of its own.
de.settingsHelpScopeThisProject: Saved inside this project, so it travels with a copy of it.
de.settingsHelpShowTheToneMapButton: Put the tone map button on the Viewer bar. Tone mapping folds a picture brighter than the screen can show back into what it can, so the detail up there can be seen while you work — it is a way of looking, and it never reaches an export. Off unless you ask for it.
de.settingsHelpSmoothThePictureWhenZoomed: Off, a pixel magnified past 1:1 stays a square, which is what you zoom in to see. On, the picture is blended between pixels — softer, and easier on the eye when the zoom is for framing rather than for inspecting.
de.settingsHelpSurroundTakesThemeColours: Off, the area around the picture is a neutral grey — a grade cannot be judged against a tinted surround. On, it matches the rest of the shell.
de.settingsHelpThisProcess: What the system says Lumit is holding, all in — the number Activity Monitor and Task Manager show.
de.settingsHelpTransformInEffectControls: Repeat the layer's Transform rows above its effects. The Timeline already shows them when a layer is twirled open.
de.settingsHelpVideoArrivesAsASequence: Video and image sequences added to a composition become a Sequence layer, which can be cut into clips on its own row. Still images are never wrapped.
de.settingsHelpVramBudget: How much video memory finished frames may hold, of the {total} on the card.
de.settingsHelpWaveformsRiseFromTheBottom: A waveform stands on the floor of its row instead of being centred about silence, each column reaching up by how far the sound swung either way. Half of a centred wave is a mirror of the other half, so this spends the whole row on the half that says something — useful in a short row. Applies to the single wave and the frequency stack alike.
de.settingsHelpWaveformsShowTheFrequencySta: A layer's waveform draws as three stacked waves — bass, middle and treble — instead of one. A loud passage is a solid block on a single wave whichever instrument is playing; the stack shows the kick apart from the hats, so a cut can be aimed at either. Turn it off for one plain wave.
de.settingsHelpWhenTheMachineCannotKeep: Adaptive keeps time and softens the picture; every frame keeps the picture and takes the time it needs.
de.settingsPasteLayersAtTheirOriginal: Paste layers at their original time
de.settingsSmoothThePictureWhenZoomed: Smooth the picture when zoomed in
de.settingsVideoArrivesAsASequence: Video arrives as a Sequence layer
de.settingsWhenTheMachineCannotKeep: When the machine cannot keep up
de.sourceAssetNote: This is an asset — every layer using it changes.
de.stretchAnchor: The in point holds; the end of the layer moves.
de.timelineEmpty: Open a composition, or drop footage here to make one.
de.tokenAccentHelp: The one accent: focus, the playhead, what is chosen.
de.tokenAccenthoverHelp: The accent with the pointer on it.
de.tokenAnimatedHelp: Keyframes, the stopwatch when it is on, a handle or value field in hand, and the work-area band.
de.tokenCachediskHelp: The disk tier of the Timeline's cache bar.
de.tokenCurveHelp: A property's stroke in the graph editor.
de.tokenHairlineHelp: The line between rows and panels.
de.tokenHairlinestrongHelp: The same line where it has to carry more weight.
de.tokenMarkerHelp: Comp markers on the time ruler, and the box holding what one says. A grey by default — a marker says *here*, not *careful*.
de.tokenSelectionfillHelp: Under a selected layer or property; half as strong under a highlighted one.
de.tokenSuccessHelp: Something finished, or held in the cache.
de.tokenSurface0Help: The deepest ground — behind panels, and the app backdrop.
de.tokenSurface1Help: A panel's own ground, and the Timeline inside the work area.
de.tokenSurface2Help: Rows and cards lifted off the panel.
de.tokenSurface3Help: A field or button at rest.
de.tokenSurface4Help: The same, with the pointer over it.
de.tokenTextdisabledHelp: A control that cannot be used right now.
de.tokenTextmutedHelp: Hints and the lines under a setting.
de.tokenTextprimaryHelp: Names, values, anything you read first.
de.tokenTimelineoutofrangeHelp: The Timeline's ground either side of the work area, so the part you are delivering reads apart from the rest.
de.tokenWarningHelp: Something worth reading before carrying on.
de.tokenWaveformhighHelp: The top band — hats, sibilance, transient edge.
de.tokenWaveformlowHelp: The bottom band of the multiwave stack — kicks and bass.
de.tokenWaveformmidHelp: The middle band — most of a voice, a snare's body.
de.tokenWaveformrestHelp: The single wave a layer or a clip draws. Content, not state — never the accent.
de.trackFailedFollowing: The frames could not be followed
de.trackFailedNoFeatures: Too little in the shot stayed still enough to follow
de.trackFailedNoFrames: There are no frames to analyse
de.trackFailedNoSolve: The shot does not carry a camera move that could be solved
de.trackFailedNotPlanar: What is inside the shape is not one flat surface
de.trackFailedRotationOnly: The camera only turned, so there is no depth to recover
de.trackFailedUnreadable: The media could not be read
de.trackLinkLost: The solve could not be found
de.trackSolvedPartial: Analysed {frames} of {total} frames — the shot could not be followed further
de.typeVerticalNotBuilt: Vertical type is not built yet — the engine lays out one horizontal line
de.updateBadReleaseData: The releases API answered something else
de.updateCheckDidNotFinish: The last check did not finish.
de.updateChecksumMismatch: The downloaded update did not match its checksum
de.updateOfferBody: {name} is {size}. Lumit downloads it now and installs it when you restart, so you can carry on working in the meantime.
de.updateReady: {installed}. Lumit {version} is downloaded and installs when Lumit restarts.
de.updateReadyInPlace: Lumit {version} is ready. Restarting puts it in place and opens it — no installer, and nothing to answer.
de.updateReadyInstaller: Lumit {version} is downloaded. It installs while Lumit is closed, so the update finishes the next time you open it.
de.updateRestartFailed: Lumit is updated, but could not start itself again
de.updateSwapFailed: Could not put the update in place
de.updateUnknownVersion: Could not tell which version of Lumit this is
de.workspaceFileUnwritable: That file could not be written.
